# Proposed Fix — tile_pandas_creating_inspecting / s04 incorrect feedback

## File
`batches/final_batch_009_da_pandas/tile_lessons/tile_pandas_creating_inspecting.json`
(and its public mirror `batches/final_batch_009_da_pandas/tile_lessons_public/tile_pandas_creating_inspecting.json`)

## Location
Inside the step with `"step_id": "tile_pandas_creating_inspecting.s04"`, under
`feedback → incorrect → message`.

## Current value (wrong)
```
"Review how to load a CSV file with `pd.read_csv()`."
```

## Correct value (as specified by the evaluator)
```
"Make sure you use `pd.DataFrame(dict_of_lists)` for df1 and `pd.DataFrame(list_of_dicts)` for df2, then print both."
```

## Diff (conceptual)
```diff
-  "message": "Review how to load a CSV file with `pd.read_csv()`."
+  "message": "Make sure you use `pd.DataFrame(dict_of_lists)` for df1 and `pd.DataFrame(list_of_dicts)` for df2, then print both."
```

## Why the generator could not self-repair
The gate and evaluator both flagged this same finding across 2 full repair loops of
stage 08_pedagogy_review (and it also appeared in earlier 04_interactions gate loops).
The generator kept regenerating the step but never corrected this specific feedback
string, likely because the scaffolding comment in the starter code says
"# Data loaded from CSV (scaffolding)" which confused the model into thinking the
exercise was CSV-related.

## Action
A human must open the two JSON files above, find the `s04` step, and change the
`feedback.incorrect.message` string as shown. After saving, rerun the pipeline —
stage 08_pedagogy_review will re-evaluate and should PASS.
